title: glaucium corniculatum var. rubrum
intro: Glaucium corniculatum var. rubrum, commonly known as Red Hornpoppy, is a plant species that belongs to the Papaveraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Glaucium corniculatum var. rubrum include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help in relieving pain and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as glaucine and protopine, which exhibit therapeutic actions like sedation, analgesia, and antispasmodic effects.
